# Hibiki

Hibiki is a TypeScript webhook framework for Node.js 22+ and Web Standard runtimes. It has zero runtime dependencies in Core and provider packages.

Use `new Hibiki().use(provider)` to create an immutable type-state builder, `on("provider.event", handler)` to register one handler, and `handle(request, { provider })` to verify, parse, and route a request. Core supports Stripe and GitHub provider packages. GitHub accepts JSON payloads only.

Hibiki does not store events, retry deliveries, log payloads, or provide queues. See README.md for the basic example and packages/*/src/index.ts for API documentation.
